testimony.subject: Circumstances of fee patent issuance and subsequent land sale
testimony.key_claims: Della Charbonneau, age 40, is a Rosebud Sioux allottee who received a fee patent by mail in March 1917 in Detroit, Michigan without having applied for it. She did not remember signing a receipt and accepted the patent without protest. She no longer owns the land, having sold it for $3,840.00 cash with no debts and no mortgage. She is in good health, has no dependents, and is employed as a modiste.
